text.p: Thai private power producer, the Cogeneration Plc, said on Monday its wholly-owned units, Thai Cogeneration Co Ltd and MTP Cogeneration, will raise their registered capital to finance power plant constructions.

Thai Cogeneration will hike its registered capital to 2.55 billion baht, while MTP Cogeneration's capital will be increased to 1.03 billion baht through share issues, Cogeneration said in a filing to the Thai stock exchange.
Details of the share issues were not available from the company.
Cogeneration did not give details of the registered capital figure of Thai Cogeneration and MTP Cogeneration before the hike.
Thai Cogeneration is building a 200-megawatt power plant worth about 12.84 billion baht, Cogeneration said.
MTP Cogeneration owns a 140-megawatt cogeneration plant valued at about 5.37 billion baht, it said.
